  <p class="eyebrow">How it will work</p>
  <h2 id="method-heading">Discovery, classification, review.</h2>
  <ol class="process-list">
    <li><strong>Discover</strong><span>Find material from allow-listed sources and retain original metadata.</span></li>

  </ol>
